definitions.T(predicate): Integral of a Boolean predicate over eligible time. Return null if the denominator is zero.
definitions.MAD: Median absolute deviation about the sample median.
definitions.gates: Approach/entry, apex, exit and next braking reference are fixed for each circuit/version/corner; map or empirically register them on a held-out reference; never use player minimum speed to define the apex gate.
definitions.t_turn: First sign-correct abs(q)>=0.08 crossing in entry held for 0.15 s; adaptive noise floor may only be substituted through a new preprocessing version.
definitions.sustained: 0.15 s unless a feature specifies another threshold; 0.03 hysteresis for throttle-on off state; retain crossing bracket.
definitions.coverage: Fraction of registered analysis interval supported by eligible interpolation brackets. Check rate from median spacing on native packets and max gap before interpolation.
definitions.bounds: Null if gate missing, flashback/pit crosses window, active validity unsuitable for requested analysis, denominator undefined, or values exceed the observable dynamic range.

channels.t: Game session time in seconds with session UID and unrewound frame counter; OpenF1 UTC parsed to relative seconds.
channels.s: Metres along a versioned centerline, unwrapped. Game lap distance after coordinate validation; real public distance is estimated or supplied by a separately validated map.
channels.v: Speed m/s; divide game and real km/h by 3.6.
channels.B: Brake on/off; public 0/100 or bool; game B via 0.05-on/0.03-off hysteresis and 0.12 s persistence before downsampling.
channels.u: Game normalized throttle [0,1]. Real public throttle signal is separately typed; never assumed equivalent to the game pedal.
channels.q: Game normalized steering command [-1,1]; device, calibration, sensitivity, deadzone and assists metadata required for cross-player interpretation.
channels.gx: Game longitudinal G along the documented convention; verify forward-acceleration sign on clean straight.
channels.gy: Game lateral G; verify axes and signs on constant-direction corners.
channels.yaw: Game heading/yaw radians, unwrap per continuous segment.
channels.yaw_rate: Verified MotionEx yaw component rad/s, or differentiated yaw with source typed; validate axes per format.
channels.pose: Game world position metres and forward/right basis; real public positions are approximate and need a separate scale, time alignment and map QA.
channels.wheel_slip: Game MotionEx per-wheel slip ratio and slip angle, wheel order RL/RR/FL/FR; validate sign and units per game build before use.
channels.surface: Game tyre surface categories, plus contact state where that field is available and version-verified. Categories alone do not establish contact.
channels.lap: Final lap time, game validity, completion, pit/flashback state, optional events and explicitly recorded intent.
channels.context: Task, weather, layout, version, assists, device, setup, compound/age, traffic/flags and available energy-state metadata.
channels.reference: Comparable player or approved cohort reference trace, with the same gates and preprocessing.

kin.filter: Derive from native valid samples. Linear interpolation inside valid continuous segments only. Recompute at matched native/public bandwidth when comparing domains; no interpolation of packet gaps larger than the limit.

game_input.filter: Resample continuous variables at 20 Hz within clean segments; reflect-pad centered second-order seven-point Savitzky-Golay (0.35 s window) for derivatives; use hysteresis on unfiltered commands for discrete transitions.

public_binary.filter: Sample game's debounced state using the public observation cadence for the comparison. Retain transition brackets (last off/first on etc.); use midpoint estimates and propagate the half-interval uncertainty. No smoothing or interpolation of binary state as pressure.

aggregate.filter: Accept only passing input rows with the same metric, preprocessing and context; group by session first; no numeric imputation.

features.formula: s(apex_gate)-s(t_B_on); positive before the fixed gate
features.interpretation: Relative brake onset; earlier means larger.
features.known_confounders: Brake thresholds, sample cadence, alignment, gear/energy recovery, aero drag, grade and grip.
features.failure_conditions: No bracketed onset within predeclared entry window or apex gate unavailable

features.formula: v(t_B_on) from the onset bracket midpoint
features.interpretation: Speed at brake activation.
features.known_confounders: Brake thresholds, sample cadence, alignment, gear/energy recovery, aero drag, grade and grip.
features.failure_conditions: Required channel/gate missing or quality policy failed

features.formula: t_B_off-t_B_on for the declared main episode
features.interpretation: Duration of sustained activation.
features.known_confounders: Brake thresholds, sample cadence, alignment, gear/energy recovery, aero drag, grade and grip.
features.failure_conditions: Episode truncated, unbracketed, or merged across a missing-data interval

features.formula: sum(dt with B=1)/sum(valid dt) over fixed window; use bracket midpoints
features.interpretation: Coarse occupied time within a registered window.
features.known_confounders: Brake thresholds, sample cadence, alignment, gear/energy recovery, aero drag, grade and grip.
features.failure_conditions: Required channel/gate missing or quality policy failed

features.formula: max(b) from t_B_on through t_B_on+0.20 s
features.interpretation: Early game brake command magnitude.
features.known_confounders: Device map, assists, setup, grip, trajectory, vehicle speed and driver intent.
features.failure_conditions: Required channel/gate missing or quality policy failed

features.interpretation: How quickly brake command builds.
features.known_confounders: Device map, assists, setup, grip, trajectory, vehicle speed and driver intent.
features.failure_conditions: Either crossing missing or crossing interval <0.10 s

features.formula: t_20_fall-t_80_fall for sustained post-peak crossings of b_peak

features.known_confounders: Device map, assists, setup, grip, trajectory, vehicle speed and driver intent.
features.failure_conditions: Non-unique release without a sustained crossing or insufficient resolution

features.formula: (v(t_B_on)-v(t_B_off))/(t_B_off-t_B_on)

features.failure_conditions: Required channel/gate missing or quality policy failed

features.formula: T(B & t>=t_turn & t<=t_apex & 0.05<=b<=0.8*b_peak & db/dt<=0.05/s)/T(B) during main episode
features.interpretation: Proxy for releasing brake command while turning toward apex.
features.known_confounders: Device map, assists, setup, grip, trajectory, vehicle speed and driver intent.
features.failure_conditions: Required channel/gate missing or quality policy failed

features.formula: T(B & abs(q)>=0.08)/T(B) over entry
features.interpretation: Share of braking while steering is above threshold.
features.known_confounders: Device map, assists, setup, grip, trajectory, vehicle speed and driver intent.
features.failure_conditions: Required channel/gate missing or quality policy failed

features.interpretation: Game command overlap.

features.failure_conditions: Required channel/gate missing or quality policy failed
